newsitem.title: ITALY: Minimum rate 8.01 pct at Italy lira repo tender.
newsitem.headline: Minimum rate 8.01 pct at Italy lira repo tender.

text.p: The minimum rate at today's 5.0 trillion lire 15-day Bank of Italy repurchase tender was 8.01 percent, compared with 7.93 percent at the previous repo tender on November 26, the Bank said.
The average rate was 8.03 percent against 7.95 percent at the last repurchase pact for 6.5 trillion lire and six days.
The pact takes effect today or tomorrow and the securities are for resale on December 13. The Bank said it received 35 bids of which five were met in full and two in part.
